evidence.observation: Holding at 749.9 °C against a 750 °C setpoint. The ramp tracked closely. A brief 10 °C overshoot at t=2520 settled by t=2760.
Rose steadily during the ramp, then held at about 46% during growth, consistent with the thermocouple.
Ar at 100.7 sccm against a 100 sccm setpoint. Purge at 200 sccm was also on target.
Steady at about 760 Torr throughout, with no sign of blockage.
Not installed, so oxygen ingress cannot be checked.

args.missing_evidence: No exhaust O2 sensor, so atmosphere purity cannot be confirmed. At atmospheric pressure a small seal leak would not show on the pressure gauge. Post-run characterization, such as Raman or XPS for oxidation, is needed to judge growth.
